ideas.label: King Safety / Attack
ideas.summary: - Compare open lines, defenders, and flight squares before committing to an attack. - Castle or close files before the centre opens if your king is still exposed.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)

slots.worked: your king stayed safer than the opposing one behind a useful shield
slots.attention: open lines and thin defenders still expose the king
slots.lesson: compare open lines, defenders, and flight squares before committing material
slots.plan: castle or close the dangerous files before opening the centre

ideas.label: King Safety / Attack
ideas.summary: - Storm with the pawn beside the chain head so heavy pieces gain open files. - Do not push if the defender can seal the wing and counterattack the abandoned pawns.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)

slots.worked: the pawn storm began opening useful attacking files
slots.attention: the wing advance still needs entry squares before it creates only weaknesses
slots.lesson: push the pawn beside the chain head to open files without stranding your own king
slots.plan: bring heavy pieces behind the storm once a file opens

ideas.label: King Safety / Attack
ideas.summary: - Identify the key defender of the castled king before calculating sacrifices. - Pin, exchange, or deflect that piece so checks become forcing.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)

slots.worked: pressure already fixed a key defender near the king
slots.attention: the key defender still holds the position together
slots.lesson: remove or overload the key defender before the sacrifice lands
slots.plan: pin or exchange the defender, then force with checks

ideas.label: King Safety / Attack
ideas.summary: - A kingside pawn advance only compensates when it creates entry squares now. - If the wing can be closed, stop and fix the abandoned queenside instead.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)

slots.worked: the kingside advance created real entry pressure
slots.attention: the storm risks leaving queenside holes without entry squares
slots.lesson: commit to the storm only when entry squares appear immediately
